Figure 2. Pairwise comparison of the four MAP estimates (mm/yr), log-log axes, one common x/y range shared across all six panels (10 to 10000 mm/yr, chosen from the bulk of the pooled data, not the extremes). Solid line = 1:1; dashed = 4x/0.25x offset; dotted = 8x/0.125x offset. Points with either coordinate outside this range are shown clamped to the edge as a triangle (not dropped) and named here as (x, y) in their true, unclamped mm/yr values. (a) ERA5 vs BADM: n=631, rho=0.578; off-scale: IT-MBo (1365.0, 24150.4); US-CF1 (550.0, 9.0); US-HB4 (1429.0, 658044.6); US-TLR (469.4, 1.0). (b) ERA5 vs BIO12: n=780, rho=0.592; off-scale: IT-MBo (407.0, 24150.4); PE-QFR (611.0, 9.0); US-CF1 (1350.0, 658044.6); US-HB4 (1276.0, 1.0); US-TLR (2705.0, 10291.8). (c) ERA5 vs tower-measured: n=469, rho=0.975; off-scale: IT-MBo (1341.8, 24150.4); US-HB4 (9581.3, 658044.6). (d) BADM vs BIO12: n=632, rho=0.933; off-scale: none. (e) BADM vs tower-measured: n=375, rho=0.900; off-scale: none. (f) BIO12 vs tower-measured: n=469, rho=0.869; off-scale: none. Version B: 4x/8x-cluster sites in a second colour, drawn on top; membership rule in the shared legend and .legend.txt.
